summary:
The selected passive-telemetry decision separates capture, attribution and delivery. The first repository-tool source window reads bounded local cumulative token_count samples without invoking a receiver or provider process. It strips inherited metadata health claims; missing health/workspace observations and queue values remain absent/Unknown, readiness Pending, and capture NoAcceptedCaptureClaim. Actual fresh authenticated observations retain the existing strict healthy identity, freshness and exact zero/lossless queue checks.

The collector bounds files, bytes, lines, events and diagnostic output. Partial or malformed tails, changed/rotated sources, unavailable lineage, missing observed zero baseline, cumulative reset and young sessions withhold complete-period totals rather than inventing zero. Available cumulative samples remain visible and are never summed as separate requests. Complete local windows remain explicitly unverified LocalCounterDiagnostic; the strict verified counter classifier is unchanged. The native response/turn reader, dispatch attribution and journal are unchanged. Modern-only records have unavailable diagnostic totals, not zero tokens or complete native capture.

This source was independently reviewed with inert actual-main Python controls; actual FSharp adapter/compile and required hosted qualification remain separate and unclaimed by this record. The maintained workflow exercises the actual collector and FSharp adapter. Durable passive modern-response capture through the existing reader, pending-publication journal, bounded spool, cursor and correction paths is the next concrete application window. Receiver access/ingestion/deduplication/restart/restore and prospective programme attribution retain separate acceptance. No new framework, telemetry wire schema, provider keys/configuration, receiver installation or publication is introduced. Local observations grant no execution authority or original-effect release; unavailable historical outcomes and original holds remain retained.
title: Local diagnostic observation is independent of receiver readiness
